description: This script handles uploading and processing of test report XML files, including parsing, summarizing, and uploading test data to S3, as well as managing test JSON artifacts during workflow runs.

methods.name: should_upload_full_test_run
methods.description: Determines if the full test run dataset should be uploaded based on branch and repository rules.

methods.name: parse_xml_report
methods.description: Converts an XML test report into a list of JSON-serializable test case dictionaries, adding metadata.

methods.name: process_xml_element
methods.description: Recursively converts an XML element into a JSON-serializable dictionary, converting attribute values to numbers where possible.

methods.name: get_tests
methods.description: Downloads, unzips, and parses XML test reports into a list of test case dictionaries.

methods.name: backfill_test_jsons_while_running
methods.description: Downloads existing artifacts, parses XML reports, and uploads missing test JSONs during a workflow run.

methods.name: summarize_test_cases
methods.description: Aggregates test cases by class, file, and job ID, producing summarized test run data.
